messages.subject: Multiple Apps - choose though html
parts:
Hello -

I have two apps I want to host. First one will be at http://www.MYDOMAIN.com/app1 and second one at http://www.MYDOMAIN.com/app2. If a user goes to http://www.MYDOMAIN.com I want them to look at some nice links to each of those apps -- and not just showing the name of the two directories. How would I do that? Put an index.html file in /srv/shiny-server that links to the two apps? Would that work? Anybody tried this or something else?

Thanks,
D.

messages.author: 9349b31ec7c243b2
messages.subject: Re: Multiple Apps - choose though html
parts:
Tried it out. It worked with a simple index.html file in /srv/shiny-server

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<body>

<p><a href="http://www.MYDOMAIN.com/app1"><img style="border:0;" src="app1.png" alt="App1" width="400" height="300"></a>

<a href="http://www.MYDOMAIN.com/app2"><img style="border:0;" src="app2.png" alt="App2" width="400" height="300"></a></p>

</body>
</html>
